// This is the 'C' code used to generate the CRC table for DOW-8 CRC (Poly = 0x8C)

#include <stdio.h>

#define POLY 0x8C

int main(void)
{
  int      i     ;
  int      index ;
  unsigned x     ;
  unsigned temp  ;
  
  for (index = 0 ; index < 256 ; ++index)
    {
      temp = index ;
  
      for (i = 0 ; i < 8 ; i++)
        {
          x = temp & 1 ;

          temp >>= 1 ;
          
          if (x != 0)
            {
              temp ^= POLY ;
            }
        }
  
      printf ("0x%02X, ", temp) ;

      if ((index & 7) == 7)
        {
          putchar ('\n') ;
        }
    }

  return 0 ;
}
